reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the 7.5% tolerance instead of recomputing it.

duplication.why: The tolerance and worst-case logic exist once in the shared helper; schedule-template's own isbetween dispatch is even removed in favour of the helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the range worst case; callers only pass their op.

scope.why: Besides planning paths it also routes display/search sites (ScheduleAmountCell's 'Approximately X' label, SchedulesTable/mobile filter strings) through the worst case, so the UI shows 'Approximately 107.50' for a 100.00 schedule, beyond the planning request.

maintainability.why: One definition with an op parameter is clear, but the op is optional so any caller that forgets it silently gets the old rule, and display vs planning uses are not distinguished.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (op === 'isapprox' branch using getApproxNumberThreshold); all planning callers pass their op to it
